title: Oracle AI Buildout — Sites, Financing, Guarantees & Compute Contracts (2026-11-10)

blocks.h: Scope: every Oracle AI/OCI site, approvals, size and timeline; every corporate and project-level financing; guarantees, leases and structured products; every compute-rental contract. Built 2026-11-10 from SRS Quartr (filings, calls, Oct 28 2026 Investor Day), Cleveland/BWG/Third Bridge, AlphaSense broker research, FactSet, Insider Score (8-K/424B), press, county/PSC/TCEQ/NMED records. Tags: confirmed = filing/company/regulator; reported = press; estimate = broker/channel. Structured copies live in Supabase (ai_dc_sites, ai_financings, ai_guarantees_obligations, ai_compute_contracts, ai_financing_metrics; ticker ORCL).
Key takeaways

items.h: Capacity: ~3GW live → ~10GW by end FY28 (Investor Day 10/28/26). Five GW-scale Stargate sites ≈5GW; only Abilene is live (618MW / 6 of 8 buildings, Sept 2026). Frontier, Jupiter, Lighthouse and Michigan all target first delivery in CY27; Jupiter (NM) and Lighthouse (WI) carry the most approval risk.

Corporate raises Jan 2024–Nov 2026: $102bn gross = $67bn senior notes + $5bn mandatory convertible preferred + $20bn ATM + $10bn marketed common. $68bn of it since Sept 2025. The Nov 2, 2026 $10bn notes came at 7.00–8.65% vs 4.45–6.10% in Sept 2025.

Off-balance-sheet: ~$76bn+ of project debt at Oracle-leased sites (Vantage TX/WI $38bn, Jupiter NM $18bn, Michigan $14bn bonds, Abilene ~$9.6bn). Oracle is the tenant, and its unconditional rent is the collateral. Leases signed but not yet commenced: $288bn (Aug 31, 2026), 15–19-yr terms.

Credit: S&P cut Oracle to BBB- on 7/9/26 and Moody's is Baa2 negative. 5-yr CDS went from \<40–70bp → ~300–329bp (Oct 2026). Jupiter loans quoted 89–91c, and banks hedged with CDS ($9.2bn traded in 10 weeks to 12/5/25).

Contracts: RPO $664bn (FQ1 FY27), ~13% recognized in 12 months. OpenAI is the anchor (~$300bn / 4.5GW, reported; Oracle confirmed in an 8-K >$30bn/yr from FY28 but did not name the customer), now \<50% of RPO per brokers. Since FQ3 FY26, new deals are mostly customer-prepaid or bring-your-own-chips ($75bn of RPO; $11.4bn prepaid in FQ1 FY27).

Guarantees: no chip-vendor guarantee to Oracle is confirmed. SemiAnalysis says ~0.6GW of Oracle leasing relies on Nvidia credit wrappers; Nvidia's 10-Q shows $3.5bn of guarantees for unnamed AI cloud partners. Oracle itself guaranteed up to $3.3bn of a lessor's debt (matured Sept 2026), $2bn of DTE bills (MI), and faces a >$7bn letter-of-credit ask in WI.

blocks.title: Stargate Abilene (Lancium Clean Campus) - core 8-building campus

items.h: Capacity: 1.2GW is the gross campus power figure. Oracle 2026-09-10: 6 of 8 buildings = 618MW = 75% of total capacity delivered [confirmed] → implies ~824MW total customer (IT) capacity (derived as 618/0.75; not a disclosed number). Phase 1 = 2 buildings, 980k sq ft, >200MW [reported, NBF 2025-05-12]. Phase 2 = 6 buildings; campus ~4M sq ft, 1.2GW [reported].
GPUs:
Oracle Q2 FY26 (2025-12-10): >96,000 NVIDIA GB200 delivered [confirmed].
Q1 FY27 (2026-09-10): 131,000 GPUs delivered in the quarter, 1.9x Q4 [confirmed].

Power: ERCOT grid interconnection (TD Cowen 2026-10-28: "1.2 GW ERCOT-approved grid interconnection") plus behind-the-meter gas turbines for bridge/backup power (>300MW BTM plant, Abilene Reporter-News 2025-10-14).

Cost / financing: $15B JV of Crusoe, Blue Owl and Primary Digital [estimate]. ~$11.6B of debt plus equity secured by mid-2025 [reported]. Crusoe CEO: a 1GW powered shell costs ~$19.2B before ~$40B of chips/servers (The Information 2026-06-09).

Risks / delays: Higher-than-expected complexity and cost: backup power, cooling, grid-stability rules, labor (The Information 2026-06-09). Cleveland 2026-03-25: a supplier said Oracle had power-quality problems at 'Stargate TX 1' in Sept 2025, since improving. The expansion beyond the core campus was dropped.

blocks.h: Management funding framework

items.h: 2025-12-10 (Kehring): "we expect and are committed to maintaining our investment-grade debt rating". He listed bond, bank and private debt, bring-your-own-chips customers, and suppliers who "may lease their chips rather than sell them".

2026-02-01 (Oracle PR): "Oracle expects to raise $45 to $50 billion of gross cash proceeds during the 2026 calendar year … approximately half … through … equity-linked and common equity". Executed as $25bn of notes, the $5bn mandatory convertible and the $20bn ATM.

2026-03-10 (Q3 FY26 release): Oracle "does not expect to have to raise any incremental funds to support these contracts as most of the equipment needed is either funded upfront via customer prepayments … or the customer buys the GPUs and supplies them to Oracle."

2026-06-10 (Q4 FY26): "In fiscal year 2027, Oracle expects to raise approximately $40 billion … including its previously announced $20 billion at-the-market equity issuance. Oracle does not expect to issue additional debt…" Net capex outlay is about $70bn. Reported capex is $20–25bn higher because of customer prepayments and timing.
2026-10-28 (Maxson, Investor Day): "this $20 billion, split evenly between debt and equity, is the final amount needed to fund the remainder of this cycle". Other commitments made that day:
Gross debt flat apart from refinancing.
Net debt/adj. EBITDA (including leases and vendor financing) below 3.5x by FY29.
FCF positive in 2H FY28 and above $30bn in FY29.
Buybacks effectively stopped; dividend held at $0.50 a quarter.
2026-11-02: the full $20bn was executed within 5 days.
Morgan Stanley (11/3/26): about $5bn / $4.75bn / $6.25bn of FY27/28/29 refinancing, plus possibly tens of billions of vendor financing, sit outside the "$20bn and done" framing.

Structured products and credit-market signals

items.h: Bank CDS hedging: about $9.2bn of Oracle CDS traded in the 10 weeks to 12/5/25, against $410m a year earlier (Barclays). Banks underwriting Oracle-tenant construction loans drove it.

Michigan project bond: the $14bn of 7.5% 2045s is the only capital-markets security tied to an Oracle lease.
IG-rated construction loans: ≥$56bn (Vantage TX/WI + STACK NM).

ABS/CMBS: no Oracle-dedicated ABS or CMBS was found. QTS securitizations include Oracle among tenants. Total DC securitization was $27bn in 2025 (KBRA). No CLN or synthetic risk transfer on Oracle-linked loans was found.
Secondary loans: Jupiter loans were quoted at 89–91c in Sep 2026. Per Cleveland, a bank holding Oracle-linked debt at 250bp could not sell it at 400bp.
Other:
Oracle holds 15% of the TikTok USDS JV (equity method) and sold Ampere to SoftBank for $4.3bn (11/25/25).
It sells customer financing receivables without recourse: $1.9bn in FY26 and $652m in FQ1 FY27.
It held $2.6bn of restricted cash at 8/31/26, purpose undisclosed. It may be collateral such as the ATC security; this is unverified.

Protections:
RPO is non-cancelable.
Oracle pays no rent until facilities and utilities are delivered (FQ2 FY26). Exceptions: the STACK NM lease (per SemiAnalysis) and unconditional Michigan rent (per Fitch).
Data center vendors require significant termination fees (FY25 10-K).
On customer contracts, management said "We're not talking about LDs". No termination or repricing terms are disclosed.
Oracle may defer contract ramp steps by up to 12 months (SemiAnalysis, Saline).
PO pricing is locked for the next 18 months.
Concentration:

10-K FY26: no customer ≥10% of revenue, but "in certain OCI offerings, we are more concentrated among a number of large customers". It also flags the risk of being locked into multi-year excess data center commitments.
At Investor Day, management said the first large AI RPO came from a single customer in FY26, and each later quarter diversified it.
